title: Download a file from the web using wget
summary: Use wget to download a file from a URL. By default, it saves the file with the name from the URL, but you can specify a different name or location.

steps.explain: Download the file from the given URL. The file will be saved in the current directory with the name from the URL.

placeholders.name: URL
placeholders.description: The full URL of the file to download

alternatives.explain: Download the file and save it with a specific name or path.

placeholders.description: The local path and filename to save the download to
